sections.heading: Section 7
paragraphs: In the dynamic arena of agricultural exports in India, the Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA) stands as a cornerstone institution. An APEDA license is essential for businesses to export agricultural and processed food products. In this blog, we will discuss the APEDA license registration process, why one should register with APEDA, the eligibility and documentation required for an APEDA license on the go, the penalty for default and the online APEDA license registration certification process.

The APEDA license is a certification provided by the Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India. The license is mandatory for exporters of diverse agricultural and processed food products such as fruits, vegetables, cereals, and dairy products. Having an APEDA license registration means the products will meet the standards of the quality set by the government for export.
Other products scheduled for release under APEDA include:
Products of fruits, vegetables, and their products

APEDA is pleased to introduce online APEDA license registration, which will be valid for life; however, it is the duty of exporters to check/modify their profile from time to time and adhere to APEDA rules.
Market Access: Getting an APEDA license gives you plenty of access to the world, boosting exports. It helps build credibility and trust with foreign buyers.
Financial assistance: The government provides various financial assistance schemes, including marketing and subsidy for quality improvement, to registered exporters.
Quality Assurance:APEDA license registration ensures products meet quality standards for the international market, reducing the chances of rejection at international borders.

Who needs to register with APEDA?

Any individual, partnership, company, or organization exporting scheduled products specified under the APEDA Act must register with APEDA. This includes exporters of fresh and processed fruits, vegetables, meat, dairy, alcoholic/non-alcoholic beverages, and herbal/medicinal plants.
How long does it take to get APEDA registration?
The APEDA registration process typically takes 1–3 working days after submitting a complete application with all required documents and fees.
Can I apply for APEDA registration without an IEC?
No, an Import-Export Code (IEC) issued by the DGFT is mandatory for APEDA registration. You must obtain the IEC before applying for APEDA registration.
Can I track my APEDA application status?
Yes, you can track your application status on the APEDA website using the application number generated during submission. After approval, you can view the RCMC certificate under the RCMC menu.
